description: Implementation of the ProductRelationshipDao interface for managing product relationships in the sales manager system, utilizing JPA/Hibernate queries for data retrieval based on various filters such as type, group, and product.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for ProductRelationship entity, providing various methods to query product relationships based on different criteria.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product relationships by type, store, product, and language.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product relationships by type, store, and language.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves product relationships by group code.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all relationship groups that are not associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves product relationships by store and type.

methods.name: listByProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all product relationships involving a specific product.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves product relationships by store, type, and product.
